The decisive error occurred when the Planner failed to distinguish between 'Director' and 'Supervising Director' roles in Step 15, leading it to ignore Pete Michels' valid credit as a director and incorrectly conclude he was the primary director in error. This flawed premise caused the final answer to focus on the wrong conflict resolution or to extract the wrong name as the sole director.
